label: PF Backlog 581
title: EPIC: Enterprise Data Plane (DB & Storage) - PostgreSQL system of record + object store + tenant isolation + data residency
body:
## Goal
Build the provider-neutral enterprise data plane from docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md: one canonical data-access layer
(RelationalStore / ObjectStore / ArtifactService / MemoryRepository / JobStore / OutboxStore / CacheStore /
SecretStore / AuditStore / BackupProvider / Search-Provider), PostgreSQL as the relational system of record,
object storage for bytes, server-verified tenant isolation, and a versioned data-residency policy.

## Locked decisions (2026-10-13)
- L1 Language rule = **Go**: new shipped/sensitive data-plane logic is Go; existing Python stays (compiled);
  every item must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py (BI-PF-0387/0388 baseline).
- L2 WorkerGrid is the single job/lease truth; PF pipeline run-state is separate but is NOT a second queue.
- L3 config/store-registry.json becomes the versioned data-ownership catalogue + automated coverage gate.
- L4 Residency is a versioned, fail-closed policy engine; legal profiles (IN-v1/US-v1) are counsel-owned
  inputs, never encoded legal conclusions.

## Execution
Phases are gates, not calendar. Waves: Phase 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> 6 -> (7 evidence-gated).
Do NOT start broad data migration before Phase 0 inventory + Phase 1 contracts/rollback are complete.
Migration rule: no big-bang rewrite; preserve domain APIs; read old/write new only after parity; keep Git for
code/config, not live customer state.

Source doc is the authority for scope; this epic is the authoritative work breakdown.

decisions.note: L1=Go; L2=WorkerGrid single job/lease truth; L3=store-registry catalogue; L4=residency fail-closed policy. BI-PF-0402 folded in; BI-PF-0391/1202/0332/0414 cross-linked.

Sequencing: storage/DB (EDP) is the GATING program. No conflicting persistence/tenancy/audit/eventing/run-state work starts before the owning EDP milestone lands (hard surgical block). Editions/profile decisions: PG16 min; one S3-compatible adapter; OIDC/JWT target; RLS hardening; residency schema owned by residency module embedded into packaging manifest.

objective: Build the provider-neutral enterprise data plane from docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md: one canonical data-access layer
acceptance_criteria: Every data store has an owner, source-of-truth decision, data classification, residency disposition and migration plan (Phase 0 exit gate).
All persistence goes through provider-neutral interfaces with shared local + cloud conformance tests (Phase 1 exit gate).
No P0 cross-tenant leakage, arbitrary file access, secret exposure, data loss, or unaudited privilege escalation (release gate).
No production deploy with anonymous auth, dev token fallback, superuser DB runtime role, public bucket, or missing restore runbook.
No migration cutover until data parity and rollback are demonstrated; no 'enterprise scale' claim without reproducible evidence.
L1 enforced: new data-plane logic is Go and passes language_rule_review.py.
